description: This file defines cultural information for the datejs library specific to the French language as spoken in Monaco, including locale-specific date formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time portion of the Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the Date object with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the numeric index of the day based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Gets the numeric index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month and year.
